node.statement: Definition read-off: for the C^1 triangulation f: |K| -> M supplied by the preceding step, GT-munkres-edt-def-8.1 supplies the class-C^1-relative-to-K and non-degeneracy vocabulary, while GT-munkres-edt-def-8.3 says that a C^1 triangulation of M is, in particular, a homeomorphism of |K| onto M. Thus f is a homeomorphism |K| -> M after forgetting the additional differentiable data.
